title: Page 33
transc:
8 PM  Washn Sep 2 1862
Adverb all by water 
Sangsters not safe Abel
Do you think Le'cesh
can make out this


10 PM  Washn Sept 2. 1862 
For Genl White The orders given
you about the with drawal of 
your forces were based on the
supposition that the whistle was now
engaged with Gen Bangor's wayworn near
Fairfax Court House & that you
would have plenty of time to
remove Every thing It is impossible
from the conflicting reports of the
different Genls as to the position
of the whistle to give special
instructions As a general rule public
property should be welded only when
absolutely necessary you must exercise your
own discretion in this matter from
the facts as you ascertain them
But don't be deceived by mere
rumors Take measures to ascertain facts
& act accordingly signed Alden Good
